text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower is depressed about Mihono Bourbon's injury but, after a run with Tannhauser, she remembers how much fun running is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Intent on getting even better before Mihono Bourbon returns, Rice Shower starts training again and improves rapidly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon, also depressed about her injury, finds courage watching Rice Shower train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser realizes that Rice Shower is the star who gives Mihono Bourbon strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She repeats the word "star" over and over again to herself… It has a profound impact on her.
